title: Training status (get_training_status)
description:
Returned by garminconnect's get_training_status(date). Consumed by sync_training_status. Device-keyed nesting confirmed live: mostRecentTrainingStatus.latestTrainingStatusData is keyed by deviceId (string), not a flat dict — code must iterate .values() and pick the entry with primaryTrainingDevice=true.

Verified against: 2026-07-24, 2026-08-05 (via automatic drift-check on live data, #68 — see mostRecentTrainingLoadBalance.recordedDevices.category/imageURL), 2026-08-06 (mostRecentVO2Max/mostRecentTrainingLoadBalance/mostRecentTrainingStatus all observed null right after day rollover, before Garmin had computed anything for the new day yet — now nullable). Additional fields beyond what's listed here may exist and are tolerated (additionalProperties: true) — Garmin adding new fields is not a breaking change; a listed field disappearing or changing type is.
